_what: Trastuzumab baseline + HER2 epitope. Every score in this challenge is relative to trastuzumab, and the <70% CDRH3 identity gate is computed against cdr_h3 below.
_verified: Checked against the provided data on the VM, 14 Nov 2026. The parent row is NOT in the 524k FACS table (that table holds variants only) — it is in trastuzumab_her2_spr_all_768.csv, where cdrh3 == WGGDGFYAMD appears 8 times as the reference antibody. vh below matches that row exactly. vl was filled in from it. Rebuild with ruhit/gen/scripts/build_fixtures.py, which writes ~/data/tidy/trastuzumab_parent.json.
_numbering_warning: cdrs_kabat below is Kabat (11-residue cdr_h3). The provided tables and the challenge novelty filter use a 10-residue CDRH3, WGGDGFYAMD. Compute the <70% identity gate on the 10-mer — see cdr_h3_gate.

sources: trastuzumab_her2_spr_all_768.csv, vl_sequence of the 8 rows with cdrh3 == WGGDGFYAMD
identical in all 524,346 rows of tz_her2_facs_3classes_524346.csv (the light chain was never varied)

length_budget._use: An scFv design that keeps both domains at parent length has 23 aa of slack before abguard rejects it on length. A linker counts against this.

measured_baseline._use: This is the binding number a design must beat to score on that axis. It is sub-nanomolar, which is why the plan treats affinity as the hard axis and thermostability as the beatable one.

cysteines._use: Both domains carry exactly their canonical intra-domain pair. A design with an odd count in either domain has an unpaired cysteine and abguard rejects it.

cdrs_kabat.source: US app 20190194349 (CDR1/2/3 given explicitly with trastuzumab framework); cdr_h3 independently confirmed inside the vh sequence above as ...YYCSR-WGGDGFYAMDY-WGQGT...
cdrs_kabat.note: cdr_h3 here is the 11-aa Kabat call. The challenge does NOT use it — see cdr_h3_gate below.

cdr_h3_gate.source: The cdrh3 column of both provided tables, and Data/12-her2/her2_cdrh3.yaml, which designs heavy-chain B residues 99-108 — ten positions.
cdr_h3_gate._use: Compute every identity and novelty check against this 10-mer, because it is what the provided tables and abguard are defined against.

optimisation_track_rules._note: At most 70% identity over 10 positions means at least 3 must differ. The design must ALSO differ at 2+ positions from every one of the 525,063 provided CDRH3s, so a design that merely rediscovers a screened variant is rejected. Conservative 1-2 point mutants WILL be rejected.

cdr_h3_gate.reference_set: ~/data/tidy/provided_cdrh3_universe.txt on the VM — all 525,063 unique provided CDRH3s, one per line, for the novelty check.

contact_regions.source: 8PWH only — a domain IV loop not resolved in earlier structures; MD suggests it stays associated with trastuzumab

her2._use: De novo designs must be epitope-conditioned on these residues. A binder that hits HER2 anywhere else cannot compete with trastuzumab, so it can never be S-tier however tightly it binds. Use these as hotspots for RFD4-Proteina conditioning.
her2._caution: Residue numbering is for full-length HER2 including signal peptide (UniProt P04626). Confirm the offset against whatever construct the generation model and abguard expect before using these as hotspot indices — an off-by-22 (signal peptide) error here is easy and silent.
